purpose: post-blind manual-rubric judgments for the systematic MAP fidelity audit
processNote: All 89 blind responses were committed before rubric exposure. While locating the CR-bearing source after that freeze, one non-CR source file containing auto-scored keys was opened before the six rubric judgments were recorded. This does not alter the already-frozen blind answers; the deviation is recorded explicitly rather than represented as a stricter sequence than actually occurred.

g8s-cr-001.notes: Frozen response identifies foam/Container C, cites 63°C versus 54°C and 44°C, calculates the smaller 17°C drop, and connects greater retained temperature to less thermal-energy transfer.

g8s-cr-002.notes: Frozen response uses the unchanged 36.0 g total mass and explains that the same atoms are rearranged into gas and solid products without entering, leaving, being created, or being destroyed.

g8s-cr-003.notes: Frozen response uses all four food/population values, identifies the overall increase with food, and explicitly uses the 46-to-48 plateau from 20 to 30 g/day to explain nonconstant response and possible additional limiting factors.

g8s-cr-004.notes: Frozen response cites native cover falling 72% to 31% and insect species 18 to 11, avoids claiming proof of causation, and proposes repeated/comparison-site and environmental measurements as strengthening evidence.

g8s-cr-005.notes: Frozen response uses the 210/122/55 kg seasonal evidence, relates vegetation to lower local sediment loss, and connects repeated erosion/transport/deposition over 25 years and several kilometers to a channel shift of tens of meters.

g8s-cr-006.notes: Frozen response calculates Design A's 6,500 L/day reduction versus Design B's 1,900 L/day reduction and proposes relevant continued monitoring such as weather, soil moisture, field use, or maintenance.
